title: Oolong — one fact, one owner
description: Core primitives, base behavior and kit appearance form one UI module. Extensions add optional dependencies; automation and tests use the same scene.

layers.name: Kit
layers.summary: Skins, theme scopes and useful composition
layers.contract: A skin fills the existing behavior element. ThemeOwner advances the palette; scopes resolve it.

layers.name: Base
layers.summary: Editing, fields, choices, overlays and reading
layers.contract: Controllers own values and policy. Higher features compose scene, text and content primitives.

layers.name: Core
layers.summary: Scene, text, content, publication and runtime
layers.contract: One attachment and action mechanism. One source owner. Explicit output admission and writer progress.

consumers.name: Optional extensions
consumers.summary: Markdown, highlighting, mathematics, diagrams and SSH
consumers.contract: Independent dependency modules implement small core content or host contracts.

consumers.name: Semantic automation
consumers.contract: Queries and typed actions use the real scene on the owner turn. Observation does not cause work.

consumers.name: Contract tests
consumers.contract: Application, scene and physical-terminal behavior are verified at their actual boundaries.

owners.projection: Element, target, frame snapshot and bounded observation
Editor layout, logical selection and change map
Immutable source snapshot and passive renderer result
Transcript layout, reading anchor and kit skin
Frozen content, candidate batch and receipt
Immutable scope and resolved instance palette

progress.name: Source ended
progress.detail: EOF creates a final source revision; a preview cannot finalize it.

progress.name: Preparation accepted
progress.detail: Identity, revision and finality match the document owner.

progress.name: Publication accepted
progress.detail: Immutable content and output responsibility transfer.

progress.name: Writer admitted
progress.detail: Exact encoded bytes enter the bounded writer queue.

progress.name: Bytes written
progress.detail: The physical watermark settles the publication receipt.
